reader_subset: First history of each family at 50% in both modes; one generative current question and one deterministic subtotal question per state.
primary: Mean over histories of six exact slot checks (five retrospective as-of dates and the final current state); T2 minus H-paced at requested 50% separately in both modes.
secondary: T1 minus T1-no-NLI, historical exact slot, deletion checks, harmful adoption, objectively helpful or harmful verifier effects, sample reader accuracy and actual calls.

bootstrap.method: Percentile interval from paired family mean differences; B4 seeds are averaged within history first. Secondary intervals are exploratory and unadjusted.

hypothesis: Positive T2 minus H-paced means learned pacing improves exact memory accuracy. Always report the direction and interval including unfavorable outcomes.
